content.label: Examiner note - the functional group runs the chemistry
content.body: A functional group is the atom or group of atoms that determines a compound's chemical properties, and every member of a homologous series carries the SAME one. That is the whole grammar of Unit 4: name the series, name the group (-OH, >C=C<, -COOH, -COO-), and the reactions follow. Bond-counting rules (C four bonds, H one, O two) keep your structures honest.
